sanskrit_verse: कन्या नृत्युम् उपेक्षेत बान्दवेभ्यो निवेदयेत । ते चेन् न दद्युस् तां भर्त्रे ते स्युर् भ्रूणहतिभिः समाः ॥
transliteration: kanyā nṛtyum upekṣeta bāndhavebhyo nivedayet | te cen na dadyus tāṃ bhartre te syur bhrūṇahatibhiḥ samāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: If a maiden is neglected in dance by her kinsmen, and those kinsmen do not bestow her in marriage according to Dharma, then such kinsmen incur the sin equivalent to that of slaying the unborn.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests with the Dharma-prescribed guardian to ensure timely marital alignment
Causation arises through omission of sacred duty towards the maiden's conscious unfoldment
Capacity-based responsibility is assigned to the kinsman who holds guardianship
Restoration logic demands rectification of relational integrity between family and societal Dharma
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of harm caused by neglecting life-phase transitions
executable_legal_axioms: IF a maiden eligible for marriage is denied ceremonial participation AND her kinsmen fail to arrange svadharma-appropriate union, THEN assign causal liability to the designated familial guardian.
IF omission results in disruption of conscious maturity process of the maiden, THEN initiate restoration protocol for lineage harmony.
IF any male relative obstructs or ignores the maiden’s transition into grihastha ashrama, THEN enforce completion process aligned with Vedic marital procedures.
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning delayed or denied marriage rites, the Supreme Court shall assess whether the custodial male relatives have fulfilled their dharmic obligation. The threshold of responsibility lies in the failure to act in accordance with svadharma progression. Retribution has no place; only restoration of lineage integrity and reintegration of disrupted consciousness cycles are admissible outcomes.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that neglect of ritual-maturation duties causes unseen karmic distortion. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how unaddressed neglect disrupts future generations. Proportional responsibility aligns with degree of guardianship authority. The non-punitive reality rule confirms that correction occurs through realignment rather than suffering-infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Grihastha Samskara Completion Process for the affected maiden under priestly supervision
Assign ancestral remediation rituals to restore lineage energetic coherence
Implement Consciousness Restoration Protocol for all involved parties to dissolve residual trauma fields
Realign familial roles via Vedic Ashrama-dharma counseling until natural order resumes
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this directive flows as pure Dharma, restoring balance where it was disturbed, without recourse to punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates, and Dharma prevails eternally.
